verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an agent product that exposes a backend API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented sandbox, test mode, or staging environment. Per-user isolated cloud machines (jo-docs-13) are tenant isolation, not a separation of test from production data. The pre-connection demo (jo-docs-19) is an adjacent product tour, not a testing sandbox, so neither earns credit.
